- [USER] User asked for tips on what to look for when selecting an art class.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for selecting an art class, including:
  1. Define your goals for the class.
  2. Research the instructor's qualifications and teaching style.
  3. Consider class size and structure.
  4. Ensure the class focuses on the desired medium and materials.
  5. Check the level of expertise required.
  6. Review the schedule and duration of the class.
  7. Compare costs and value.
  8. Read reviews and testimonials from previous students.
  9. Evaluate the studio or venue's atmosphere and facilities.
  10. Look for clear communication from the instructor or studio.
  11. Understand the flexibility and refund policy.
